en.title: At what height is there snow in Slovenia? From 2,000 m up
en.description: At what height is there snow in Slovenia? From 2,000 m up. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Slovenia on 16 November.
en.lede: Most of the ground in Slovenia is white from about 2,000 m up. Below that, the slopes are mostly green or brown.

sections.h: The height that makes the difference
p: That height is the number to compare with a resort's lifts: what matters is how much of the area lies above it.
1,130 km² of snow-covered ground in Slovenia this Monday, down 80 km² on yesterday. In other words, 15 % of the mapped high ground is white.

Climb and the snow gets deeper: 500-1,000 m: on average 1 cm (12 % of the ground white); 1,000-1,500 m: on average 1 cm (17 % of the ground white); 1,500-2,000 m: on average 2 cm (35 % of the ground white); 2,000-2,500 m: on average 6 cm (74 % of the ground white).

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: Think 2,000 m and higher for a white landscape. A week ago it was 220 km², so the cover has grown by 910 km².
At the top of the list, Gače reports 28 cm.
Then come Vogel (26 cm), Velika planina (24 cm), Rogla (17 cm) and Golte (16 cm).
At Vogel: 1 cm of fresh snow over three days, 0 cm more expected by Thursday 19 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 15 out of 27 resorts in Slovenia.

The rest of the shortlist: Velika planina: 24 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 0 cm expected; Rogla: 17 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 0 cm expected; Golte: 16 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 0 cm expected.
Over the next three days up to 7 cm is expected, and up to 7 cm over the week.
Thursday 19 November stands out, with up to 6 cm in a day.
The second week adds up to 33 cm where it snows most.

sections.h: New snow in the last three days
p: The last three days were dry or nearly so, with no more than 1 cm anywhere.

Here is how the deepest resorts compare with their usual 16 November: Gače: 3 cm at about 822 m, against 0 cm in a normal year; Vogel: 1 cm at about 1,152 m, against 1 cm in a normal year; Velika planina: 1 cm at about 1,536 m, against 0 cm in a normal year; Rogla: 3 cm at about 1,288 m, against 0 cm in a normal year.
3 of these 4 resorts are above their usual depth for the date.
These depths are for one height on each mountain, below the top, so they read lower than the upper-slope numbers further down.
In past winters the best snow at Gače usually came mid-February / late February.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Austria: 38 % white, deepest Kaprun with 83 cm, up to 50 cm in the week ahead; Italy: 23 % white, deepest Monterosa Ski with 99 cm, up to 75 cm in the week ahead.
The snow is retreating uphill, so plan on the higher lifts and avoid the low valley runs.

advice: Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.
Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.
Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.

sl.title: Snežne razmere v Sloveniji, 16. novembra 2026: smučišča, novi sneg in naslednji dnevi
sl.description: Sneg v Sloveniji 16. novembra: snežna odeja, novi sneg, višina po nadmorski višini, naslednji dnevi in najboljša smučišča.
sl.lede: V Sloveniji je danes pod snegom približno 1.130 km² (ponedeljek, 16. novembra). To je 80 km² manj kot včeraj. To je 15 % gorskega območja v Sloveniji, ki ga spremljamo.

p: Snežna meja je okoli 2.000 m. V primerjavi z 220 km² pred sedmimi dnevi je to 910 km² več.
Zadnje tri dni skoraj ni snežilo: največ 1 cm.

Višina snega je odvisna od nadmorske višine: 500–1.000 m: povprečno 1 cm (12 % pod snegom); 1.000–1.500 m: povprečno 1 cm (17 % pod snegom); 1.500–2.000 m: povprečno 2 cm (35 % pod snegom); 2.000–2.500 m: povprečno 6 cm (74 % pod snegom).
Odjuga načenja odejo: zjutraj trd sneg, popoldne moker.
Teden lahko prinese do 7 cm, od tega do 7 cm v naslednjih treh dneh.
Najbolj snežen dan: četrtek, 19. novembra, do 6 cm.
Kasneje, v dneh 8–14, lahko na najbolj zasneženih pobočjih pade še do 33 cm.
Največ snega na zgornjih progah: Gače, 28 cm.
Sledijo: Vogel (26 cm), Velika planina (24 cm), Rogla (17 cm) in Golte (16 cm).

advice: Pred odhodom preverite, ali naprave obratujejo.
Na začetku sezone je sneg nad kamni tanek: ostanite na urejenih progah.
